name: Securities Financing Instruction 002 V 11
definition: Scope|An account owner sends a SecuritiesFinancingInstruction to a securities financing transaction account servicer to notify the securities financing transaction account servicer of the details of a repurchase agreement, reverse repurchase agreement, securities lending or securities borrowing transaction to allow the account servicer to manage the settlement and follow-up of the opening and closing leg of the transaction.|The account owner/servicer relationship may be:|- a global custodian which has an account with a local custodian, or|- an investment management institution which manage a fund account opened at a custodian, or|- a broker which has an account with a custodian, or|- a central securities depository participant which has an account with a central securities depository, or|- a central securities depository which has an account with a custodian, another central securities depository or another settlement market infrastructure, or|- a central counterparty or a stock exchange or a trade matching utility which need to instruct the settlement of securities financing transactions to a central securities depository or another settlement market infrastructure.||Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent,|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information,|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information using the relevant elements in the Business Application Header.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as known by the instructing party.

TransactionTypeAndAdditionalParameters.name: Transaction Type And Additional Parameters
TransactionTypeAndAdditionalParameters.definition: Securities financing transaction identification information, type (repurchase agreement, reverse repurchase agreement, securities lending or securities borrowing) and other parameters.

NumberCounts.name: Number Counts
NumberCounts.definition: Count of the number of transactions linked.

Linkages.name: Linkages
Linkages.definition: Link to another transaction that must be processed after, before or at the same time.

TradeDetails.name: Trade Details
TradeDetails.definition: Details of the securities financing deal.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Financial instrument representing a sum of rights of the investor vis-a-vis the issuer.

QuantityAndAccountDetails.name: Quantity And Account Details
QuantityAndAccountDetails.definition: Details related to the account and quantity involved in the transaction.

SecuritiesFinancingDetails.name: Securities Financing Details
SecuritiesFinancingDetails.definition: Details for the closing of the securities financing transaction.

SettlementParameters.name: Settlement Parameters
SettlementParameters.definition: Parameters which explicitly state the conditions that must be fulfilled before a particular transaction of a financial instrument can be settled. These parameters are defined by the instructing party in compliance with settlement rules in the market the transaction will settle in.

StandingSettlementInstructionDetails.name: Standing Settlement Instruction Details
StandingSettlementInstructionDetails.definition: Specifies what settlement standing instruction database is to be used to derive the settlement parties involved in the transaction.

DeliveringSettlementParties.name: Delivering Settlement Parties
DeliveringSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of delivering settlement parties.

ReceivingSettlementParties.name: Receiving Settlement Parties
ReceivingSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of receiving settlement parties.

CashParties.name: Cash Parties
CashParties.definition: Cash parties involved in the transaction if different from the securities settlement parties.

OpeningSettlementAmount.name: Opening Settlement Amount
OpeningSettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money to be paid or received in exchange for the securities at the opening of a securities financing transaction.

OtherAmounts.name: Other Amounts
OtherAmounts.definition: Other amounts than the settlement amount.

OtherBusinessParties.name: Other Business Parties
OtherBusinessParties.definition: Other business parties relevant to the transaction.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

SettlementAmountRule.definition: If the Transaction is against payment, then OpeningSettlementAmount must be present.

SellerSSI2Rule.definition: If standing settlement instruction applies and the transaction is a securities borrowing, then Seller must be present.

BuyerSSI2Rule.definition: If standing settlement instruction applies and the transaction is a securities lending, then Buyer must be present.

DeliveringDepositoryAndParty1Part1Rule.definition: If the transaction is a reverse repo and no standing settlement instruction applies, then DeliveringDepository and Party1 must be present.

ReceivingDepositoryAndParty1Part1Rule.definition: If the transaction is a repo and no standing settlement instruction applies, then ReceivingDepository and Party1 must be present.

DeliveringDepositoryAndParty1Part2Rule.definition: If the transaction is a securities borrowing and no standing settlement instruction applies, then DeliveringDepository and Party1 must be present.

ReceivingDepositoryAndParty1Part2Rule.definition: If the transaction is a securities lending and no standing settlement instruction applies, then ReceivingDepository and Party1 must be present.

SecuritiesMarketPracticeGroupGuideline.definition: The Securities Market Practice Group (SMPG) has published market practice recommendations on the use of this message.|These market practices are available on www.smpg.info.

SellerSSI1Rule.definition: If standing settlement instruction applies and the transaction is a reverse repo, then Seller must be present.

BuyerSSI1Rule.definition: If standing settlement instruction applies and the transaction is a repo, then Buyer must be present.
